title: Lifting a section into an ideal-power-torsion-free module
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, I a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal module with monic inclusion into the structure module [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk, pqf-def-coherent]. Let F be a quasi-coherent module with no sections locally annihilated by any recursive ideal power. Let U be the surjective-stalk locus, one(n) lift 1 on U, and r be compatible restrictions of recursive powers. Every section s of F on U is the value at one(n) of a morphism from some recursive ideal power to F.

source.place: Tags 01PM and 01PQ, torsion-free affine denominator construction and finite affine gluing.

proof.text: Use the free module on the empty type as a genuine zero object Z. The zero map a:Z -> F is monic and Z is quasi-coherent. Its section image is precisely zero; htf identifies this with every ideal-power annihilator. Its cokernel projection is an isomorphism. Apply the existing affine quotient-lifting theorem with the constant system (Z,a), and compose its local maps with the inverse cokernel projection.

Choose a finite affine cover by quasi-compactness, and let n be the maximum of its local degrees. Precompose each lift with r to obtain maps alpha at degree n. The recursive inclusions are monic (induction on powers using image inclusions); on sections they are injective. The equation hr and naturality together with hone therefore show r carries one(n) restricted to any subopen of U to the corresponding one at the smaller degree. Consequently every alpha evaluates to s on all subopens inside U.

For two alpha maps on an overlap W, restrict their values on a power section b to W intersect U. The power inclusion is injective and carries one(n) to 1, so b on this open equals its structure-sheaf image times one(n). Linearity and the common evaluation s make the two values equal there. Injectivity of restriction for torsion-free F makes the values equal on W. Glue the maps at degree n by sheaf morphism descent. Restrict the claimed global evaluation to U intersect each affine chart; naturality and the local evaluations prove equality. Sheaf separation proves the global evaluation. Empty affine covers are included.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01PM and 01PQ; zero-annihilator specialization of affine quotient lifting, with immediate overlap agreement from torsion-free restriction injectivity.

lean.statement:
theorem ideal_power_torsionFree_section_lifting
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.Modules}
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono ι]
    [I.IsQuasicoherent] [I.IsFiniteType] [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens) (one : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ((idealSheafPower ι n).1, U))
    (r : ∀ (n m : ℕ), n ≤ m →
      ((idealSheafPower ι m).1 ⟶ (idealSheafPower ι n).1))
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom)
    (hone : ∀ n : ℕ, (idealSheafPower ι n).2.app U (one n) = (1 : Γ(X, U)))
    (hr : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
      r n m h ≫ (idealSheafPower ι n).2 = (idealSheafPower ι m).2)
    (htf : ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) (x : F.val.obj (op W)),
      (∀ (V : X.Opens) (h : V ≤ W)
        (b : (idealSheafPower ι n).1.val.obj (op V)),
        ((idealSheafPower ι n).2.val.app (op V) b : Γ(X, V)) •
          F.val.map (homOfLE h).op x = 0) → x = 0) :
    ∀ s : Γ(F, U), ∃ (n : ℕ) (ψ : (idealSheafPower ι n).1 ⟶ F),
      ψ.app U (one n) = s
